history.name: Moving an existing ledger to a new tone
history.description: The command ledger style rewrite prints a brief for rewriting a ledger that is already written into the tone the project has moved to. The agent works one area at a time and replaces the words in place, so nothing lands on the release and no entry is marked as changed.
history.dev_notes: assets/RESTYLE.md, filled with the product name, the style section, the entry count and the area list.
